claim: Human-Robot Collaboration involves robots working alongside humans in various settings like homes, hospitals, and manufacturing.
quote: These include robots for homes, hospitals, and offices, space exploration and manufacturing.

claim: Human-Robot Collaboration is an interdisciplinary field involving robotics, AI, and cognitive sciences.
quote: HRC is an interdisciplinary research area comprising classical robotics, human-computer interaction, artificial intelligence , process design, layout planning, ergonomics, cognitive sciences, and psychology.

claim: Collaborative Robots, or cobots, are used in industrial applications to interact with humans in shared workspaces.
quote: Collaborative Robots , or cobots, that physically interact with humans in a shared workspace to complete tasks such as collaborative manipulation or object handovers.

claim: The belief-desire-intention (BDI) model is used in intelligent agents research to model decision-making processes.
quote: The BDI model is characterized by the implementation of an agent's beliefs...desires...and intentions...to deliberate their decision-making processes.

claim: Human emulation and human complementary are two approaches to human-robot collaboration.
quote: The approaches to human-robot collaboration include human emulation (HE) and human complementary (HC) approaches.

claim: Human-robot collaboration requires communication to define goals and coordinate actions.
quote: Any collaboration requires communication to define goals, negotiate over how to proceed and who will do what, and evaluate progress and results.

claim: The time-space taxonomy categorizes human-robot interaction based on time and location of interaction.
quote: The time-space taxonomy divides human-robot interaction into four categories based on whether the humans and robots are using computing systems at the same time (synchronous) or different times (asynchronous) and while in the same place (collocated) or in different places (non-collocated).

claim: Ergonomics is crucial for sustainable human-robot collaboration, using models and sensors to optimize metrics like muscle fatigue.
quote: Human factors and ergonomics are one of the key aspects for a sustainable human-robot collaboration. The robot control system can use biomechanical models and sensors to optimize various ergonomic metrics, such as muscle fatigue.

claim: Humanoid robots are used in medicine for developing complex prosthetics.
quote: Humanoid robots are being used to develop complex prosthetics for individuals with physical disabilities such as missing limbs.

claim: Humanoid robots can function as robotic nurses for the elderly.
quote: Humanoid robots can be used as test subjects for the practice and development of personalized healthcare aids, essentially performing as robotic nurses for demographics such as the elderly.

claim: Humanoid robots are used in entertainment as animatronics in theme parks.
quote: In contemporary theme parks, humanoid machines are widely used as sophisticated animatronics that mimic human motion, facial expressions and speech.

claim: Humanoid robots participate in sports-style events and competitions.
quote: Outside of theme parks, humanoid robots increasingly appear in live sports-style events and competitions.

claim: Humanoid robots are used as performers in concerts and televised shows.
quote: Humanoid robots have also been used as performers in concerts and televised shows.

claim: Humanoid robots are used in professional combat leagues.
quote: In July 2026, EngineAI debuted Ultimate Robot Knock-out Legend (URKL), a professional combat league for human-sized humanoid robots.

claim: Humanoid robots are used to demonstrate new technological advancements.
quote: Though many real-world applications for humanoid robots are unexplored, their primary use is to demonstrate up-and-coming technologies.

claim: Humanoid robots could be useful for space exploration missions.
quote: Humanoid robots, especially those with artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms, could be useful for future dangerous and/or distant space exploration missions.

claim: A gynoid is a feminine humanoid robot.
quote: A gynoid , robotess , or fembot is a feminine humanoid robot .

claim: The term 'gynoid' was first used by Isaac Asimov in 1979.
quote: The term gynoid was first used by Isaac Asimov in a 1979 editorial.

claim: Gynoids are emerging in real-life robotic applications as technology advances.
quote: gynoids are also emerging in real-life robotic applications.

claim: The term 'fembot' was popularized by the television series The Bionic Woman.
quote: It was popularized by the television series The Bionic Woman in the episode "Kill Oscar" (1976)

claim: Gynoids are often depicted as domestic servants or sexual slaves in science fiction.
quote: the depiction of female-appearance robots is often characterized by their use as domestic servants or sexual slaves.

claim: Gynoids have been depicted as warriors, killers, or laborers in fiction.
quote: These robots have sometimes also been depicted as warriors, killers, or laborers.

claim: The Maschinenmensch in Fritz Lang's Metropolis is the first example of a gynoid in film.
quote: The Maschinenmensch ("machine-human"), also called "Parody," "Futura," "Robotrix," or the "Maria impersonator," in Fritz Lang 's Metropolis is the first example of gynoid in film.

claim: Gynoids in fiction often reflect essentialist ideas of femininity.
quote: Fiction about gynoids or female cyborgs reinforce essentialist ideas of femininity

claim: Humanoid robots integrate mobility, manipulation, control, and AI into a human-like system.
quote: 휴머노이드 로봇은 이동(보행), 조작(manipulation), 제어, 인공지능이 하나의 인간형 시스템으로 통합되는 복합 기술 제품이다.

claim: Key technologies for humanoid robots include manipulation, control, and AI-based learning.
quote: 조작 및 로봇 손 기술, 제어·학습 기반 AI 기술, 안전·안정화·전원 등 상용화 병목 기술

claim: Humanoid robot commercialization involves overcoming bottleneck technologies like actuators and power management.
quote: 안전·안정화·전원 등 상용화 병목 기술

claim: Humanoid robot systems and their subsystems are within the domain's scope.
quote: 휴머노이드(인간형·이족보행) 로봇 시스템 자체와 그 서브시스템.

claim: Adjacent technologies like industrial robot arms and AGVs are not part of the humanoid robot domain unless they directly contribute to it.
quote: 고정식 산업용 로봇 팔(제조 자동화), AGV·물류 이송 로봇...이들은 휴머노이드 시스템에 특유하게 기여하지 않는 한 이 도메인의 대상이 아니다.

claim: General manipulation and grasping technologies can be considered borderline cases for humanoid robots.
quote: 범용 조작·파지 기술이나 4족보행의 균형 제어처럼 휴머노이드로 직접 전이되는 기술은 경계 사례로

claim: CPC B25J series includes general robot patents, which may overlap with humanoid robot technologies.
quote: 로봇 일반(CPC B25J 계열) 문헌을 폭넓게 포함하므로

claim: Humanoid robots are entering a commercial tipping point in 2026, expanding AI into the physical world.
quote: 2026년 기점으로 휴머노이드는 R&D를 넘어 상업적 임계점 진입, AI가 물리 세계로 확장

claim: The value chain of humanoid robots consists of hardware, intelligence, and data.
quote: 가치사슬 = H/W·지능·데이터 3개 축

claim: Actuators and robot hands account for about 70% of hardware costs in humanoid robots.
quote: 액추에이터·로봇손이 하드웨어 원가의 약 70% 차지하는 병목 영역

claim: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) and End-to-End (E2E) neural networks are crucial for autonomous learning and generalization in humanoid robots.
quote: VLA(Vision-Language-Action), E2E(End-to-End) 신경망이 자율학습·범용성 결정

claim: Sim-to-Real technology is essential to overcome the lack of real-world data for humanoid robot commercialization.
quote: 실세계 데이터 부족이 상용화 핵심 병목, Sim-to-Real 기술과 데이터 패권 경쟁

claim: The U.S. leads in AI foundation models and semiconductor dominance, with companies like Tesla and Figure AI pioneering industrial applications.
quote: (미국) 빅테크 AI 파운데이션 모델·반도체 우위, 테슬라·Figure AI 산업현장 실증 통한 단계적 상용화·기술표준 선도

claim: China's humanoid robot companies have a price advantage of 50-90% over U.S. counterparts due to internalization of servomotors and reducers.
quote: 중국 기업들은 서보모터·감속기 내재화로 미국 대비 50~90% 가격 경쟁력

claim: Korea's strategy for humanoid robots includes self-reliance in core component technology and alliances with global big tech for AI foundation models.
quote: 한국 전략: 핵심부품 기술 자립화 + 글로벌 빅테크 동맹 통한 AI 파운데이션 모델 확보

claim: The humanoid robot market is expected to grow significantly, with projections of 100 million units annually by 2030-2035.
quote: BofA: 출하량 2025년 약 1.8만 대 → 2030~2035년 연간 100만 대

claim: The cost of manufacturing humanoid robots is expected to decrease from $35,000 to $13,000-$17,000 within five years.
quote: 제조원가: 대당 약 3.5만 달러 → 5년 내 1.3만~1.7만 달러

claim: The humanoid robot market in Northeast Asia is projected to grow at an average annual rate of 42.4%.
quote: 동북아 연평균 42.4% 성장

claim: The commercialization path for humanoid robots involves industrial demonstration, physical data accumulation, and B2C expansion.
quote: 상용화 단계 경로: 산업용(제조·물류) 실증 → 물리적 데이터 축적 → B2C 확산

claim: Bipedal form factors are becoming the standard for humanoid robots, increasing production efficiency.
quote: 이족 보행 폼팩터가 표준으로 자리잡으며 양산 효율 증대

claim: Actuators are a critical component in humanoid robots, with rotary and linear types used for different joints.
quote: (액추에이터): 로터리(어깨·팔꿈치·손목, 감속기+프레임리스 모터) vs 리니어(롤러스크류, 무릎·허벅지, 근육 모방)

claim: The control system in humanoid robots acts like a cerebellum, converting AI commands into physical movements.
quote: (제어 시스템): 소뇌 역할 — AI 명령→물리적 움직임 변환

claim: Sensors in humanoid robots are crucial for environmental perception, balance, and manipulation data collection.
quote: (센서): 오감 — 환경 인식·균형·조작 데이터 수집

claim: The robot hand is a key end-effector in humanoid robots, determining task versatility and comprising about 20% of manufacturing costs.
quote: (로봇손): 작업 범용성 결정 말단장치, 제조원가 ~20%

claim: Embodied AI in humanoid robots involves self-learning AI with LLM-based natural language reasoning and action generation.
quote: (AI 알고리즘): 규칙 기반 제어 → 자가학습 AI. LLM 탑재 자연어 추론+행동 생성

claim: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in humanoid robots can explain the reasons for actions, addressing black-box issues.
quote: 엔비디아 알파마요 등 추론형 VLA는 행동 이유 설명 가능(블랙박스 해결)

claim: End-to-End (E2E) neural networks in humanoid robots process sensor inputs to action outputs in a single network.
quote: (E2E): 센서 입력→행동 출력 단일 신경망

claim: Sim-to-Real technology involves virtual learning transferred to real robots, using domain randomization and data augmentation.
quote: (Sim-to-Real): 가상 학습→실제 로봇 이식. 도메인 무작위화(DR), 데이터 증강

claim: The humanoid robot value chain consists of six stages: R&D, component supply, OEM manufacturing, distribution, end-user, and after-service.
quote: 가치사슬 6단계: ①연구개발(R&D) ②부품 공급 ③완제품 제조·통합(OEM: 소프트뱅크 로보틱스, 테슬라) ④유통 ⑤최종사용자 ⑥사후서비스(KAWADA로보틱스, PAL로보틱스)

claim: Linear actuator integration accounts for 27% of the value in humanoid robots.
quote: Linear Actuator Integration 27%

claim: Rotary actuator integration accounts for 24% of the value in humanoid robots.
quote: Rotary Actuator Integration 24%

claim: Dexterous hands account for 19% of the value in humanoid robots.
quote: Dexterous Hand 19%

claim: AI chips and computing account for 10% of the value in humanoid robots.
quote: AI Chip·Computing 10%

claim: Vision systems account for 4% of the value in humanoid robots.
quote: Vision System 4%

claim: Heat management systems account for 2% of the value in humanoid robots.
quote: Heat Management 2%

claim: Batteries account for 2% of the value in humanoid robots.
quote: Battery 2%

claim: China leads in hardware manufacturing for humanoid robots, while the US excels in AI and computing, and Korea is strong in batteries.
quote: 중국이 하드웨어 제조 전반 주도, 미국은 AI·컴퓨팅, 한국은 배터리 강세

claim: The US has a vertical integration advantage in actuator and control design for humanoid robots.
quote: 테슬라·Figure AI 수직적 통합(액추에이터·제어 자체 설계)

claim: China has been the leader in global humanoid robot patent filings over the past five years.
quote: 최근 5년 휴머노이드 관련 전 세계 특허 출원에서 중국 압도적 1위

claim: Japan specializes in components like reducers and servomotors but struggles with complete humanoid products.
quote: 일본: 부품 강국(감속기·서보모터)이나 완제품 고전

claim: Korea's humanoid robot strategy includes vertical integration of capital, infrastructure, and core technologies.
quote: 대기업 자본·인프라 + 로봇 전문기업 원천기술 수직계열화

claim: Germany's humanoid robot industry focuses on precision processing and HRI.
quote: 독일: 정밀가공, HRI 4

claim: The K-Humanoid Alliance aims to invest over 1 trillion won by 2030 in Korea's humanoid robot industry.
quote: K-휴머노이드 얼라이언스: 2030년까지 민관 1조원+

claim: The KIMM strategy includes the development of a mass-production standard platform for humanoid robots.
quote: KIMM: 글로벌TOP전략연구단 — 양산형 표준 플랫폼(단가 3,000만원 이하, 1.6m/55kg, 양팔 가반하중 20kg)

claim: KIMM's strategy involves international collaboration with big tech and adherence to safety standards like ISO and NIST.
quote: 국제 협력: 빅테크 제휴(Figure AI-OpenAI 모델, ROBOTIS-MIT), ISO·NIST·EU-OSHA 안전 표준 부합화

claim: KIMM aims to create a humanoid robot capable of performing tasks in automotive processes and housekeeping.
quote: 임무: 휴머노이드 엔지니어(자동차 공정)·하우스키퍼(가사)

claim: The KIMM strategy includes the development of a humanoid robot with a foundation model for real-time motion control and autonomous learning.
quote: 파운데이션 모델(대뇌·소뇌, 실시간 운동 제어+자율학습)

claim: KIMM's strategy includes the creation of an open data factory for humanoid robots to generate and share behavioral data.
quote: 오픈 데이터 팩토리: 휴머노이드 25대+(→100대+) 동시 운영, 연 100만건+ 행동 데이터 에피소드 생성·공유

claim: KIMM's strategy involves regulatory innovation and benchmarking against US practices, including negative regulation and robot-specific insurance.
quote: 규제 혁신(美 벤치마킹): 기회특구 네거티브 규제, ANSI/RIA 안전 인증, 로봇 전용 보험·GDPR급 데이터 법제

claim: KIMM's strategy includes the development of a humanoid robot with a social brain for multimodal interaction.
quote: ④멀티모달 교감형 소셜 브레인
